title: Snake
description: Guide the snake to eat food and grow as long as possible without hitting yourself or the walls.
controls: Arrow keys / WASD, or swipe on touch devices

title: Minesweeper
description: Clear the minefield without detonating a single mine. Numbers reveal how many mines hide next door.
controls: Click to reveal, right-click to flag; tap and long-press on touch devices

title: Pipelines
description: Connect every pair of matching dots with pipes without overlapping.
controls: Drag from a dot to draw a pipe; arrow keys also work
